note: Curated from the watch run of 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13 (tools/WATCH.md). Primary sources only; a line is marked computed where the date was worked out from a rule and not announced. The advisory-committee line was checked a second time against FDA's own page.

items.what: Comments close on the HHS draft policy for BPC-157, TB-500, MOTS-c, KPV, epitalon and semax (11:59 pm Eastern). No date has been given for a final policy.
FDA says its advisory committee will meet before the end of February 2027 on LL-37, GHK-Cu, dihexa, melanotan II and PEG-MGF. No date or Federal Register notice yet.
FDA has not proposed its rule on which substances go on the 503A list; the Unified Agenda entry targeted July 2026. The HHS policy runs while that rule is written.

A citizen petition filed 2026-10-23 asks FDA not to allow compounding of the seven peptides its July committee reviewed. FDA's 180-day response mark is 2027-04-21 (computed; a tentative answer counts).
FDA has not published its final decision on keeping semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide off the 503B list (proposed 2026-05-01).

Computed from the court's rule, not announced: the window to ask the Supreme Court to review the Fifth Circuit's August 2026 rulings for FDA in the shortage cases closes about 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-30. Nobody has said they will file.
Seventh Circuit appeal, Eli Lilly v. Kennedy (No. 26-1301): is retatrutide a protein, so a biologic, or a drug? No argument date found.
FDA lists liraglutide injection as in shortage, and Novo plans to discontinue Saxenda in January 2027. A shortage listing is what lets some compounding continue.

watch.name: Berobenatide
watch.why: Pfizer registered three phase 3 trials after 2026-10-29, in knee osteoarthritis and in stress urinary incontinence, each with obesity or overweight.

watch.name: Enicepatide
watch.why: Roche registered a phase 3 cardiovascular-outcomes trial on 2026-11-05 in adults with overweight or obesity and heart disease.

watch.name: Ecnoglutide
watch.why: Sciwind registered a phase 2 trial of oral tablets on 2026-11-10 in Chinese adults with overweight or obesity.

watchNote: On the watch means a registered trial and nothing else: no regulator list, customs release, court filing or FDA letter names them, and none is on the menus yet.
